_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex, capítulo 3. A3.5a: el CRT (alargador del suelo técnico, PIN del Ledger con el cumpleaños de Gerald y el disquete que vuelve); la bebida energética ya es del cap. 2. A3.5b: PZ-BOT y la alfa falsa (p3_pzbot, notas n3_pzbot y n3_log). Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Get the old computer to talk.
Find where the humming comes from.

notes.text: Basement CRT: plug a metre short of the socket. Ledger PIN hint: 'my best friend's birthday. DDMM.'
Hidden door behind the basement equipment rack. A whole server room. Still warm.
Under the server room floor: an orange extension cord and 3D glasses with the lenses the wrong way round.
The floppy held a patient roster. PATIENT ZERO — STATUS: ESCAPED. The printout has a map. No X on it.
PZ-BOT runs the server room terminal. Only talks to its owner. Or to alpha. Locked the emergency shutoff: 'SHUTDOWN = MISSED OPPORTUNITIES.'
PZ-BOT bought $GERALD and crashed. Its log: owner wallet 0xDE... Records moved to the treatment room. Could be anyone.
Pried a fused chip out of the dead AdrianAuctions rack. The CRT's slot B7 is empty. Not that it seems to care.
Emergency switch screen: 47.6062N, 122.3321W. Patient Zero Rehabilitation Clinic. The mountain path outside the lab goes that way.

hints: You saw the light. Now find the way down.
The roof hatch has three locks: a card reader, a keyhole and the vane's latch.
Grease and turn the vane. Then use the keycard and the terminal key on the roof hatch.
Servers hum. Follow the hum.
The equipment rack in the basement moves.
Push the equipment rack.
That old screen is a metre away from being alive.
Server rooms keep their spare cables under the floor.
Open the raised floor in the server room, take the extension cord and use it on the CRT.
Adrian's Ledger wants a PIN. Its hint is a birthday.
Adrian's best friend has paperwork. It came out of the mailbox.
Gerald's vet bill: born 3 January 2009. Use the Ledger on the CRT and pick Gerald's birthday.
The vault is open. The screen wants a backup.
Somebody worked late at the little desk in the basement.
Take the floppy from the small desk and use it on the CRT.
PZ-BOT only listens to its owner. Or to alpha.
Alpha is just confident words on paper. You own a pen that won't stop writing.
Combine scrap paper or the receipt with the leaky pen. Use the fake alpha on the terminal.
Big red switch. Glass in the way.
Something long and metal. The roof had one.
Use the antenna on the emergency switch.
Nothing between you and the switch now.
It says do not touch. Touch it.
Use the emergency switch.

anonIdle: Down here, nobody hears you call. I do. Rarely.
